```{r setup}
#| include: false
source("hooks.R")
chain_hook("plot", before = function(options) { options$fig.cap <- paste(options$fig.cap, "(hooked)"); options })
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-a
#| fig-cap: "CAP-A"
plot(1:3)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-b
#| fig-cap: "CAP-B"
plot(3:1)
```

See @fig-a and @fig-b.
